It took one look and the world
couldn’t get enough. In fact, during
the year it was introduced, Camaro
was the most searched car model on
Yahoo!. It racked up numerous awards,
including MotorWeek’s 2010 Drivers’
Choice Award for Best Sport Coupe
“Everything that went into this car, from the concepting to the first
and Best Resale Value in its class for one to roll off the assembly line, was an incredible experience.
SS from Kelley Blue Book’s kbb.com.1 We wanted that same exhilaration to translate to the driver as well.”
— Ed Welburn, GM Vice President of Global Design
For 2011, the excitement of the
sports car continues. First up, a
more powerful 312 hp V6, the kind
that can keep up with V8s and
still boast 29 MPG highway.2 Next,
jaw-dropping design highlighted
by sculpted rear shoulders, available
high-intensity discharge headlamps
and eye-popping 20-inch wheels.3
And finally, technology you need, like
OnStar® Directions & Connections®
including Turn-by-Turn Navigation,
standard for the first six months;4
XM® Satellite Radio with three trial
months;5 and available Bluetooth®
wireless technology for select phones.6
Want something more open? With
more I-want-to-let-my-hair-blow-in-
the-wind freedom? Then get ready.
Chevy’s all-new Camaro Convertible
has arrived. And the thrill of driving
will never be the same. At least, not
in the 21st century.
A Consumers Digest “Best Buy”
— 2010 Camaro
